_README: SEC-recent evaluation set: numerical questions answerable from the most recent 10-K of each company already ingested in the sec_filings corpus (fiscal years 2024-2025). Built to give a VALID SEC benchmark comparable to the GCC set, because FinanceBench's questions (FY2016-2023) reference filings not in this corpus. Every gold figure was (a) confirmed present in the ingested sec_filings corpus (retrievable by ticker) and (b) checked against the company's reported headline figure for that fiscal year. Figures in US$ millions unless stated. Where minority interest exists (TSLA, KO), the answer uses the net income attributable to the parent's shareholders.
_status: 19 questions, all figures verified present in corpus + matched to reported 10-K values.
